defect: The executable/TLA lease-boundary witness required every valid one-millisecond lease to settle, even though supported runtime semantics correctly allow claim/scheduling latency to consume that lease before handler admission.

ciEvidence.finding: leaseBoundary.oneTickAccepted=false while the dedicated runtime contract test remained green

requiredFix: The proof must accept either successful settlement or exact authoritative lease-expiry interruption for a positive one-tick lease, while proving no automatic heartbeat is scheduled and no heartbeat-configuration rejection is used.
